messages:
Maya Patel: FYI — quick proposal to add 'alert suppression' + contact routing controls to Console SLOs so pagers stop firing on short-lived spikes.

Maya Patel: Sketch:
```
alert_suppression:
  window: 5m
  threshold_pct: 30
  record_only: true
contact_routing:
  primary: team-oncall
  fallback: eng-escalation
  suppress_pager_if: ["known_cause_tag"]
```

Liam Chen: :+1: want `record_only` default true. we need telemetry so suppressed alerts still emit events for regressions (don't drop).

Anita Roy: Product asked for per-route overrides (api vs embeddings). can we let teams opt-out per-route? also need RBAC check — only admins should change routing.

Sam Rivera: UI note — adding 3 extra knobs per SLO will blow up the rollout UX. suggest templates (quiet / default / strict) + an "advanced" toggle so we don't distract new users.

Jen Park: How does this interact with rate-based SLOs and quotas? if suppression hides noisy pages, teams might miss quota exhaustion that needs capacity or throttling.

Maya Patel: Good q. updated idea: `record_only=true` always — suppression only prevents paging. Console shows suppressed incidents in timeline + banner so teams can triage without being paged.

Liam Chen: Also add an auto-escalation if suppressed alerts keep recurring (e.g., escalate_after: 3/1h -> send page). otherwise suppression could mask persistent regressions.

OpsBot: Runbook linked: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/123456/alert-suppression-runbook>

Anita Roy: +1 to templates. I can mock a Settings page Wednesday and include a per-route toggle and admin-only controls.

Sam Rivera: I'll prototype the backend API: `POST /v1/slo/{id}/alert-policy` with schema fields `suppression`, `routing`, `escalation`, and template presets. assigning to @Sam.

Maya Patel: Action items:
- Sam to PR API + backend schema
- Anita to mock Console UX + templates
- Liam to add telemetry bookkeeping and suppressed-event metrics
- Jen to validate quotas interaction and ensure quota alerts aren't suppressed inadvertently
Target: spike + first PR next week. :rocket:
